jobs.title: Program Manager, State & Enterprise Programs
jobs.jd_full:
About Wonderschool

Wonderschool is the operating system for child care in America. State governments and large enterprises partner with us to run child care licensing, subsidy programs, and provider and family search on our platform. We are growing fast, and every new state or enterprise win becomes a complex, high-stakes delivery engagement.

The Role

We need a Program Manager to run our state and enterprise engagements. You will own the delivery plan, the client relationship, and the coordination between our clients and our product and engineering teams, across every active project. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time in project plans, client meetings, spreadsheets of acceptance criteria, and hard conversations about dates.

You are the person who makes sure what we promise to government and enterprise clients is what gets delivered, on time, on contract, with the paper trail to prove it.

Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery plan for each engagement across all workstreams. Track milestones, UAT cycles, and acceptance against each contracted statement of work.
  • Run the client cadence on every project: weekly status, steering meetings, escalations, and working sessions with agency program staff, legal, and state IT.
  • Keep dependency registers current. Clients owe us integration specs, test environments, credentials, data feeds, and business decisions on a schedule. Hold both sides to their dates and keep the paper trail that supports excusable-delay and change-order claims.
  • Manage scope: capability traceability, acceptance criteria negotiation, change requests, and intake of new work.
  • Produce deliverables for client review and keep Wonderschool leadership ahead of risks across the whole portfolio instead of behind them.
  • Work with engineering leads on integration timelines with state systems (ERP platforms, state data hubs, SSO). You will not own technical design, but you need to follow the conversation and know when a date is slipping.
  • Build the repeatable program playbook as we add states and enterprise clients.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of program or project management on complex software delivery. Government or regulated-industry clients strongly preferred.
  • You have managed contractual milestones, UAT-based acceptance, and formal change control, and you have the scars to show for it.
  • You write well. Status reports, meeting summaries, and acceptance criteria language will carry your name.
  • You can run a plan that depends on teams you do not manage, on both sides of the table.
  • Strongly preferred: experience with child care programs in state government (licensing, subsidy/CCAP, eligibility, or provider systems).
  • A plus: state human services or eligibility systems experience, or familiarity with state procurement.

Location and Compensation

  • Location: Remote. San Francisco preferred for in-person collaboration with the product and engineering team; open to remote candidates anywhere in the US.
  • Compensation: Market-rate base salary plus meaningful equity.
  • Benefits: Full package (health, dental, vision, 401k, flexible PTO).

jobs.title: Product Manager for Marketplace Lending, Contractor
jobs.jd_full:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is looking for a Contractor Product Manager to help drive execution across our lending marketplace. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused engagement where you will own features from definition through launch in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data. You will focus on the front-end experience that helps consumers discover and compare options across multiple lenders.

This is a contract role suited to an experienced product manager who can move quickly, operate with minimal ramp-up, and take ownership of well-scoped areas of the product. You bring the rigor to define what should be built, the discipline to prioritize ruthlessly, and the drive to see work through to shipped outcomes.

You will partner with the existing product team to keep roadmaps moving, unblock engineering, and deliver measurable improvements to the funnel. The teams you support will look to you for clear requirements, sound tradeoff decisions, and reliable execution against timelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Own Delivery End-to-End: Take assigned features from definition through launch, writing clear requirements, coordinating across functions, and driving them to completion on schedule.
  • Manage the Roadmap: Help maintain and prioritize the roadmap for your product area by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and sequencing work against available engineering resources.
  • Make Data-Driven Decisions: Use data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis where possible rather than depending on others for every question.
  • Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to scope solutions, unblock work, and deliver product enhancements against shared goals.
  • Prototype and Validate: Build or coordinate working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts before committing significant engineering resources.
  • Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where claims and disclosures matter, where human review is required, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.
  • Communicate Clearly: Keep stakeholders informed with concise updates on status, risks, and tradeoffs, and escalate blockers early.

Education and Experience:

  • At least 4 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Proven ability to own features end-to-end and ship on schedule with limited ramp-up
  • Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
  • Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools
  • Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills
  • Strong project management skills and the willingness to own critical parts of the product end-to-end
  • Technical aptitude sufficient to work closely with engineers, evaluate implementation approaches, and weigh cost and benefit tradeoffs
  • Thrive on collaboration with other teams to accomplish shared goals
  • A bias toward experimentation and the discipline to walk away from an idea when the evidence says so
  • Experience in fintech, lending, or other regulated consumer products is a plus

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Entities
jobs.jd_full:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our AI Platform group and own the systems that turn messy, unstructured case materials into accurate, structured “source of truth” data. This isn’t your typical PM role: it’s highly technical, backend-heavy, and focused on scalable AI extraction and data infrastructure. You’ll work closely with senior ML and backend engineers to build the models, evals, pipelines, tooling, and APIs that power all of EvenUp’s products.

You’ll be responsible for a mission-critical part of our AI strategy: making sure the entities we generate are accurate, consistent, and trustworthy enough for law firms to rely on. If you’ve built ML/LLM-powered data pipelines, love the challenge of turning unstructured input into structured, reliable output, and want broad impact across a fast-growing product org, this role is for you.

This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working at least 3 days a week from our San Francisco or Toronto offices. Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the roadmap for a key part of our AI Platform, potentially including RAG services, text and image extraction and analysis services, model evaluation and deployment tools, and more.

  • Partner with ML and backend engineers to build scalable, reliable, and cost-effective systems that support product teams across the company.

  • Define success metrics, analyze performance and cost data , and use insights to inform priorities.

  • Work closely with other product managers teams to understand end-user needs and develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate AI development.

  • Drive strategic decisions around model performance, vendor selection, and infrastructure scaling in a fast-evolving ecosystem.

  • Define success metrics for entity quality and pipeline performance.

  • Partner with other product managers and downstream teams to understand where entity quality or coverage gaps are limiting product experiences, and translate that into a prioritized platform roadmap.

  • Drive decisions on model performance, annotation strategy, and integration with continuous inference systems as the underlying ML approaches evolve.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a high-growth startup (Series B–E).

  • Experience building LLM/LMM-powered products or data infrastructure, with a strong understanding of how modern AI extraction and structured-data systems work end-to-end.

  • Technical fluency: you’ve worked closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, or data teams and can hold your own in technical discussions about model performance, data pipelines, and system design.

  • Comfort operating in a backend-heavy environment where your “users” are often internal teams and downstream product surfaces, and your work directly impacts data accuracy, reliability, and trust.

  • Analytical mindset: you use data to make decisions and are comfortable managing quality metrics (precision/recall, entity accuracy, coverage) alongside operational ones (latency, throughput).

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with RAG, agentic systems, and/or LLM/LMM optimization.

  • Familiarity with building internal platforms or tools that support other product teams.

  • B2B SaaS background, especially in products with significant AI or data components.

Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

  • Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.

  • Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.

  • Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.

  • 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.

  • A home office stipend.

  • 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • A local in-person meet-up program.

  • Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page .

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
WHO WE ARE

ActBlue is a nonprofit organization dedicated to creating cutting-edge technology that fuels Democratic victories and enables progressive causes to thrive.

Our vision is simple: building change through the power of people. Since our founding, we’ve been building innovative solutions to revolutionize grassroots fundraising – if you’ve donated to a Democratic campaign or a progressive organization online, you’ve probably used our platform! We believe in putting power in the hands of small-dollar donors by helping thousands of groups — from local candidates to national movements — mobilize their communities and create a lasting impact. Every member of our team is deeply committed to advancing our shared mission and core values. Together, we are shaping the future of democracy.

THE OPPORTUNITY

ActBlue is the online fundraising platform that powers most Democratic campaigns, causes, and organizations in the country. Billions of dollars flow through our platform every election cycle, and every dollar starts with someone completing a contribution on one of our forms.

Our donation form is the single most important surface in Democratic fundraising. Millions of donors interact with it every cycle. Every campaign, party, and PAC on the left depends on it converting at the highest possible rate, and the difference between a good form and a great one shows up in real dollars flowing to real races.

We’re looking for a results-driven, analytically minded Senior Product Manager to lead our core fundraising products—including donor checkout, fundraising form creation, and fundraising analytics. You’ll own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across these experiences, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to improve fundraising outcomes for campaigns across the country.

You’ll drive growth through rigorous experimentation, conversion optimization, and deep analysis of user behavior. You’ll also help define where our fundraising products go over the coming years as user expectations evolve and new technologies create new possibilities.

This is a role for a strategic product leader who wants to shape the future of digital fundraising, sharpen a category-defining product, and make a meaningful impact on democratic engagement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Protect and extend our platform’s conversion advantage through rigorous experimentation, funnel analysis, continuous iteration, and clear outcome measurement. Donation conversion is one of ActBlue’s most important competitive advantages, and you’ll be accountable for improving it.
  • Work closely with campaigns of all sizes to understand their fundraising workflows and translate their needs into scalable product solutions.
  • Reimagine how campaigns understand their fundraising performance, evolving fundraising analytics beyond dashboards toward guidance that tells users what’s happening, what it means, and what to do next.
  • Own the roadmap and execution for our core fundraising products, including the donation checkout experience, form-building tools, and fundraising analytics.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data, support, customer success, marketing, legal, and finance to deliver end-to-end value.
  • Communicate product direction and outcomes clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

LEVEL EXPECTATIONS

Senior Product Manager I

  • Independently leads product initiatives from discovery through launch within an established product strategy.
  • Owns significant product areas and makes day-to-day prioritization decisions.
  • Improves existing experiences through experimentation, customer research, and iterative delivery.
  • Contributes customer insights and product recommendations that influence broader product strategy.

Senior Product Manager II

  • Sets long-term product strategy and vision for ActBlue’s fundraising platform.
  • Owns highly complex, cross-functional initiatives with significant organizational impact.
  • Shapes investment priorities and influences executive decision-making.
  • Drives alignment across product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.
  • Represents the product strategy with senior leadership and key external stakeholders.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Direct experience with checkout flows, transaction-heavy products, or e-commerce platforms. You know what it takes to get a conversion rate to move and hold.
  • A product mindset grounded in discovery, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, design, data, and business teams.

Senior Product Manager I

  • 3+ years of product management experience with a focus on conversion optimization, user engagement, or revenue growth.
  • Experience running A/B tests, interpreting data, and using experimentation to improve products.
  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics.
  • A track record of building customer-facing experiences that drive retention and revenue.
  • Passion for outcome-driven product development and learning through iteration.
  • Experience building or improving AI-powered features is a plus.
  • Experience with authoring tools, no-code builders, or similar products is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams to ship products.

Senior Product Manager II

  • 5+ years of product management experience with a focus on conversion optimization, user engagement, or revenue growth.
  • Deep expertise leading experimentation programs and making strategic product decisions from data, while recognizing when qualitative insights are equally important.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex user behavior and business performance data.
  • A proven track record of owning high-impact products that drive customer and business outcomes.
  • Experience defining product strategy and influencing organizational priorities.
  • Experience building AI-powered products or using AI to make products significantly smarter and more useful.
  • Strong experience with authoring tools, no-code builders, or similar creator products.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed, cross-functional teams delivering complex products at scale.
  • Experience operating in high-stakes environments where product performance directly impacts business outcomes.

WORK & BENEFITS SNAPSHOT

This posting is for a full-time, remote, salaried position. Travel may be required on a limited basis to attend all-staff and departmental retreats (1-2 times per year). Additional travel may be required for select positions.

Registered States*: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, and Washington D.C.

* While ActBlue is currently registered to support remote work in the states listed above, we possess the ability to register in additional states as needed. If you are located in a state not listed, we may still be able to proceed with your application, but please note that the offer process may take longer to accommodate registration requirements.

Work Schedule:

This role requires availability during established, regular business hours (Mon-Fri).

Work Environment:

Employees can expect to work with distributed teams across all U.S. time zones. Our roles require extended technology usage, and proficiency with virtual communication tools such as Zoom and Slack. Regular attendance in virtual meetings is inherent to every position.

Salary Range Details:

Senior Product Manager, I Salary Range: $141,906- $153,026 - $164,145

Senior Product Manager, II  Salary Range: $162,027 - $178,971 - $195,915

ActBlue is committed to consistent compensation practices across our organization. Final salary offers will take into account factors such as candidate experience, interview performance and current team salary parity.

Benefits:

  • Flexible work schedules and an unlimited time-off policy
  • Fully paid and trans-inclusive health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their families; plus fully-paid health reimbursement arrangement to use for out-of-pocket expenses and fully-paid short- and long-term disability
  • Fully paid basic and AD&D life insurance and a voluntary supplemental life insurance option
  • Dependent and health care flexible spending account options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) benefits for employees
  • Automatic 2% Employer-paid 401K contribution, plus up to an additional 6% match on employee contributions
  • A minimum of three months paid medical, family and parental leave (for all new parents, adoptions included)
  • Commuter or home-office benefits, including a $1,000 home-office setup allowance for all new full-time remote employees
  • Additional perks including quarterly snack deliveries and digital subscriptions to the Boston Globe & New York Times

ActBlue is unable to sponsor work visas at this time.

UNION INFORMATION

The terms and conditions of this position are subject to a collective bargaining agreement with the Communications Workers of America, the exclusive bargaining agent of covered ActBlue Technical Services employees.

BACKGROUND CHECKS

As part of our hiring process, ActBlue will conduct a background check at the time of offer. This will be completed in compliance with applicable laws and will not be initiated without your consent.

INCLUSION STATEMENT FROM ACTBLUE

ActBlue is committed to equal employment opportunities and fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace. We celebrate unique perspectives, honor the dignity of all individuals, and recognize that diverse backgrounds and identities strengthen our mission.

If you’re passionate about our work and see yourself in this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We also provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment. To request an accommodation, email recruitment@actblue.com.

*ActBlue will _never_ ask candidates to buy equipment, nor will we email from anything other than an actblue.com or actbluetech.com email address.

jobs.jd_full:
Position Summary

Blue Acorn iCi is looking for a Senior Project Manager, with experience in Adobe Experience Cloud, who will be responsible for quality, on-budget, and on-schedule delivery of technology solutions. Areas of responsibility include project schedule variance, project financials, project success, project scope variance, project team utilization, and consistent high level of client satisfaction. We are looking for someone who is professional, reliable, and pays attention to detail. Most importantly, we seek a team player with the ability to accomplish results as a team leader and as an individual contributor.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Manages day-to-day communications and expectations to ensure project success
  • Facilitates regular status meetings via phone, video chat, and in-person meeting; generates and presents weekly status reports
  • Collaborates with internal teams, third parties and client stakeholders to ensure activities are planned and executed in a timely manner in accordance with project schedule; creatively solves problems and brainstorms solutions; communicates difficult information timely and tactfully
  • Controls quality by reviewing deliverables prior to client presentation; enhances deliverables as needed; suggests process improvements when appropriate, ensures final acceptance
  • Manages risk, threats, opportunities, blockers and associated mitigation plans that could impact the success of the project; notifying internal and external stakeholders and escalating when appropriate
  • Understands what has been sold, what Blue Acorn iCi is responsible for delivering, and ensures the delivery of those commitments

  • Creates, maintains, and executes detailed project plans
  • Coordinates tasks assignment, monitors progress, and ensures proper task completion
  • Identifies resources needed and collaborates with Resource Management to ensure optimal project staffing
  • Ensures client’s business objectives and KPIs are captured, understood, and measurable
  • Clearly understand and communicate customer requirements and integration points in the context of the statement of work.
  • Oversee project delivery process with key contributors to help manage scope and prepare change requests, including tasks, deliverables, milestones, resources, and estimated costs.
  • Manage all day-to-day administrative activities of a given project from inception to closure.
  • Accurately forecast revenue, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization across projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with both the customer and internal teams and constantly manage customer expectations.
  • Achieve customer satisfaction through successful delivery of defined project scope.
  • Compile customer requests and deployment issues, to provide a feedback channel into our core products.
  • Act as the central client point of contact throughout the life of the project
  • Capture and communicate experiences in formal post-mortem, feeding lessons learned, best practices and resources back into the consulting practice

  • Cross-functional team and people management
  • Budget and financial management including profit/loss, billing, and earned value management
  • Experience managing client and other third-party relationships
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects
  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical people
  • Ability to identify innovative ways to implement projects within established timeframes
  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, presentation)

  • Experience working at a professional services company such as an agency or consulting firm is preferred
  • Experience managing complex web development projects
  • Experience working in the eCommerce industry
  • PMP certification is a plus
